content.label: Super easy to use. Best app I’ve used for forming habits. It’s both well designed and very functional.

The nicest to-do list app I’ve ever come across. Very aesthetically pleasing, and presents the aspect in a unique way. It will actually get you to try and complete your tasks! Would highly recommend to anyone, definitely worth the price. 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

The more you succeed the more you don’t want to fail because the numbers are right there. My longest daily streak is 906 and counting. Each day I look at it and each day I don’t want to break it. It would make me feel so disappointed if I broke it. Thanks to the developers for this app. If there is a way to keep this app running in the future then I would pay again.

First things first, I'd like to say that this app is little by little changing my life. So far it has helped my kick coffee, alcohol and smoking once and for all, start meditating and exercising daily and much more. I'm not one for reviews and the fact that I'm reviewing it is testament to it's simple brilliance - and I've tried every habit tracking and to do list app there is. However for me the fact you can only have 12 tasks is becoming a real hindrance. I understand the rationale - the idea is to focus on a small number of important habits at a time rather than overwhelm yourself. However, once having internalised a habit and moving onto a new one, I still want to track my old habits (to keep me from slipping up - eg having a cigarette socially. Currently one of the screens is used up with bad habits and the other with good, but I cannot add more and so my self improvement has stopped. Please add the option to add more habits ! I'd happily pay for additional screens!

title.label: Would be perfect with a couple of updates

content.label:
Just started using this today, and it’s good. It took a few minutes to figure things out, as it’s not completely intuitive. I like it’s simplicity and the UI is very nice. 

Little things that would make this perfect for me:

- Switching between pages by swiping left and right, instead of having to tap an icon. It would just feel better. 

- The ability to log “extra” completions of habits. For instance, let’s say my goal is to do yoga once a week, but I end up doing it three times in one week. It would be really nice to be able to log that, instead of the app preventing it. It would be even better if the app made a big deal of it by tracking “extra” completions in a different colour, or something similar.
It’s great, but the one problem is marking a job off on the widget often opens the app. Please stop that. We know how to open the app - we use the widget because we don’t want to!

The UI for the settings are not intuitive at all. When you are on the main streaks page, it matters what state each item is in (icon, calendar, stats) when you tap settings in bottom left. You should be able to access all settings by just pressing settings, not having to check which state the icon is in.
Seems like one could add extra screens ...

I don’t understand the interface. There’s a bunch of icons that could mean anything. Every time I open the app for whatever reason, I find myself aimlessly tapping around in search of what I want to do. Normally I end up long-pressing something  looking for options, which I think marks the task as done — not usually what I intended. Then there’s no clear way to undo that, so I tap around a lot more. Some times the screen turns black, and my tasks disappear. I don’t know what that means. Some times I want to look at the calendar, but I don’t know how to reach it.
The best in it’s class.

Hi guys,

I'm a dev and sometimes need to change my device time for internal testing - ever since then I seem to have encountered some problems with steaks.  I often get notifications for things I have definitely done. (e.g. 10 mins mindfulness/ walk 10,000 steps - health app related triggeres) but the streak in the app longer completes, without me manually selecting it.

My device time is back to automatic and had been for a few weeks but the problem still persists.  (It may not be a device time related problem - but that's the only link I've noticed)

Otherwise - good app, good design, simple and easy to use. Although the UX for accessing the settings feels a bit confusing at times.

This app is definitely a great motivator and encourages you to persevere where you might otherwise have taken a day off.

One suggestion for the app is the ability to ‘archive’ certain streaks. 

For example, one of my streaks is ‘driving lessons’. When I ultimately finish driving lessons for good, I’ll no longer have a need for it BUT there is no option to archive. Instead, my only choice is to delete the streak entirely or change the name, which is quite anti climactic.

title.label: Please let us change the colours for each item ourselves

content.label: Otherwise really great app
I love this app!!! But you should be able to add more habits
I love this app, I would think it would be good to integrate with screen time ( if possible) so we could have Streaks for reducing screen time etc.

title.label: Could do with more than 12 achievements

content.label: Works very well and looks good, just feel for £5 it shouldn’t be limited to 12 objectives. Although I’m sure this is done to make you focus, it would be nice to be given the option to increase the number.

I have only had this app a day so I can’t speak for its long-term efficacy at helping you maintain your habits, but so far it looks like it’ll be the habit tracking app I’ll use. 

Thank you for not charging a subscription - software is not a service and I’m very happy to pay once, which I believe is a large aspect of your success over similar apps that require subscriptions.

Two changes I would like to see are:

1) Allowing more than twelve habits, and perhaps to be able to display more on-screen at once.

2) Setting a number of times a week for negative tasks. For example, I’d like to limit drinking to one night per week, but being a student it’s not very predictable what night that will be. At the moment I have to check  ‘don’t drink’ 6 days a week, but I would rather just uncheck it once per week on the day I do drink.

Do you guys think you’d be able to implement these things?
Plisse give us a way to reset all data after a period of not logging, very infuriating want to start again with accurate for 2019 and can’t seem to.

This app is wonderful, it can easily help you with any habits you want to start and any habits you want to stop. There is only two different suggestions and quires I have about this app: where can you access the settings bar ?? Looking at the pictures displayed on the App Store I can see a settings bar however on the app I ant actually access that anywhere, as well as this is would also be amazing if you could track more than 12 habits.
... but pls pls add password protection / touch ID.

This app looks nice and has innovative ui but I guess the price for that is it’s not really intuitive. I’m using it both on Apple Watch and iPhone and same actions - clicking habit once, holding it have different actions (undo on Watch, no action on iPhone) and few weeks later I just decided to give up. This should be really more intuitive. Choosing between calendar / finish task / stats view also doesn’t convince me. I’m a front end developer so I spend some time developing UIs, really not impressed with usability of this one. It does look nice though.
It's a great app and nicely designed. I think the fact it only contains 12 spaces for tasks helps you to hone in on the most important tasks you want to get done. Highly recommended!
Would love the ‘Hey Siri’ option to increment one notch in a streak instead of marking as complete.

title.label: Useful App. Use it daily last 2 yrs

content.label: Enables me to keep track of whats important and keep to a routine. What gets measured gets done. Helps me monitor daily work towards goals.

Simple, robust and does what it says it will do at a fair price. 

Feature request - can we have negative timed tasks, please? Eg if you want to reduce the amount of time you waste on something? Thanks

Handles whatever kind of task you could want, in one clunky but functional package.

Pros:
• iCloud sync.
• Broad Health support for automatic completion of tasks.
• Extensive (notification & theme) customisation.
• Universal app support (iPad, iPhone, Watch).

Technical limitation?:
• Health data retrieval (& sync) requires specifically launching the iPhone version of the app, not iPad or Watch.

Cons:
• The interface can be quite opaque, with ‘…’ buttons everywhere.
• No iCloud sync for per-task notification settings.
• Some bugs. (With Health sleep data permission granted - adding a sleep duration task works fine, but the wake & sleep task says no data is available and doesn't update from Health)

I've had this ap for a few weeks now and it has made a difference to how often I complete routine tasks that benefit me in someway. There are similar aps out there, but many charges subs of around £10 a year, whereas this one is priced sensibly at a fair, one off price. Great value considering all the features, the design and how easy it is to use. I would 100% recommend this ap.

I have used Productive for a few months now and Streaks has blown in out of the water!
What I really love is its integration with Health, Siri shortcuts and customization in aesthetics.

Some suggestions for the future.
- More trackers with deeper functionality. Eg. Track units of alcohol by asking what the user has drank. Calculate the units and add it to the weekly graph
- Location based notifications
- List view as an option

title.label: Great app. Very simple but needs room for more streaks.

content.label: The button at the bottom of the screen should reveal an iOS-multitasking-style selection of screens, each with six streaks on them. Allowing the planes themselves to have their own themes, for example the two I have now are personal improvement and health but I’d love space for more because 12 just isn’t enough. Other than that though, a great app.

title.label: A helpful daily app for getting stuff done

content.label: Streaks was recommended. I have moments of resistance to the idea of this app but realise the value of it. There are things I have to do every day & this app really helps me. Thank you. 🙏
Appalling value. £5 for a few disc buttons?! I’ve no idea where the great reviews come from, but this is elementary programming and a heap of other apps offer similar for much less cash.
Very simple and beautifully done. Needs they option to add more streaks than are currently allowed
Bit disappointing and hard to use. Instructions could be better.
Overpriced with such basic functions in

title.label: Great app, please add this little feature

content.label:
This is a fantastic app, sleek, easy to use app that has changed my life for the better. One thing I would love the developers to add is changing the time a new day starts. For now, the to do list resets at midnight, but I would love if I could change it to reset at other times, e.g. 2 AM. This is very helpful for someone who stays up late. 
Thank you very much. I hope you understand what I am asking for and if you see this please add the feature.

It’s a good app but there’s bugs. 

For example I set a streak for running a few times a week but it’s completing just by me walking!

title.label: Fantastic but needs more than 12 tasks to be even better.

content.label: This is a great app but please please please let there be more than 12 tasks!!

This is the first habit tracker - and I’ve tried a lot - that actually makes me want to complete the habits to clear a page. My only request/suggestion is for habits where you need to do it multiple times a day: currently if you miss the goal, it’s just recorded as a ‘miss’. I’d like to see how close I got, so if the target was “Read 4 times a day”, I’d want the history to show me the difference between failing on 3/4 times, 1/4 times, not at all, etc.
I would like to track more than 12 habits. I feel restricted with this app to only 12 habits

I’ve trawled the App Store like we all do looking for the right app for what I want.

If you are looking for a tracker that is both simple and fun to use packed full of options and customisable features, then this is the right app for you.

It has without a doubt, helped me break bad habits and kept me on track with good ones. 

I liked it so much I bought their streaks workout app as well so I can highly recommend streaks and the benefits it provides.

title.label: Worth it to keep track of my daily goals.

content.label:
Nice and clean. The widget for the home screen is useful. 

It has gave me a easy way to track my positive and negative habits and motivates me to make change.

Wow this app really works, I’ve used this app to get me in to a daily routine and I’ve found I’m getting the right amount of sleep, drinking 2L of water and now have so much energy that last from morning until Night. I highly recommend this app to everyone, it’s even helping fill in my fitness rings on Apple Watch, something the watch never pushed me to do.  

One request I do have... I’d love the ability to have more than 12 habits! Then I can really push myself but also most of my habits are taken up by small things like tracking my Apple Watch rings and drinking water or getting plenty of sleep. So yeah please add the ability to track more.

title.label: Great habit app but could be still be better

content.label:
This is one of the best habit apps but as other reviews have mentioned, 12 items seems a bit limited. Other habit apps often have 5-6 entries for the trial. One more panel of 6 to make 18 would be great for me at least. 

Hopefully this will be added soon. 

The watch app is very nice.
Ok app. Rating limited by unusual interface design.

One of my favourite apps of all time! Amazing for building new habits. I love the customisability of the app; you can even change the app icon… I never knew you could even do that! A MUST have for all seeking the highest levels of productivity.
This app is such a great idea AND it works perfectly!

title.label: The best one of its kind

content.label: I’ve done some research about habit-changing and/or progress tracking apps and this is the best one out there. The completion action is soulfully designed as it provides both fun and a sense of ritual significance. Love it and already recommended to my wife. And beautiful graphics too.

Probably the best habit forming app. 

Like others have said I would welcome being able to add more habits. 

Also with the wide range of sleep trackers now available for Apple Watch adding get up by ... x time as a automatic watch/help app would be great.

Great design . Love it but why restricting to 12 tasks ? Is life limited to 12 tasks only ? Will you change that ? Would be good and easier to swipe from one panel to the next rather than clicking at the bottom of the screen
Very few functionalities, not intuitive and expensive. I regret my purchase. I would have like the option to try before buying. I am now using Strides which is much better with a free version.
